description.narrative: The programme will support the National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) in developing its activities in sewerage. It will be divided in two phases SHIFT 1 and SHIFT 2. SHIFT 1 will comprise three components: -Studies & works for Negombo: Negombo is a touristic town and surround a Lagoon polluted by untreated wastewater. This component will cover the implementation of all preparatory studies and the construction of an entire wastewater management scheme, comprising 70 km of pipes
